title: operational_parameters
text: {"name":"operational_parameters","description":"Values that owners saved for the operational parameters declared by the runtime catalog in apps/api/src/parameters.ts (ADR-0028). The catalog owns each parameter's type, domain, installation default and effect; a missing row or a null value means the installation default applies. Secrets and bootstrap settings are never stored here.","owner":"runtime (operational parameters)","classification":"INTERNAL","lifecycle":"At most one row per catalog key, written only by owners through administration with strong recent authentication; a reset stores null instead of deleting. Every change is recorded in identity_audit_events with previous and new values. Retired access.providerGrants rows remain as historical evidence and are ignored by the runtime catalog; provider default groups have separate identity-owned storage.","columns":[{"Column":"key","PostgreSQL type":"character varying(64)","Nullable":"no","Default":"—","Classification":"INTERNAL","Meaning":"Catalog key of the parameter, such as ai.model.","Null meaning":"—","Unit":"—"},{"Column":"value","PostgreSQL type":"jsonb","Nullable":"yes","Default":"—","Classification":"INTERNAL","Meaning":"Saved JSON value in the catalog type of the key (string or array of strings).","Null meaning":"Reset by an owner; the installation default applies.","Unit":"—"},{"Column":"version","PostgreSQL type":"integer","Nullable":"no","Default":"—","Classification":"INTERNAL","Meaning":"Concurrency token incremented by every change; an owner's change applies only to the version they saw.","Null meaning":"—","Unit":"—"},{"Column":"updated_by","PostgreSQL type":"uuid","Nullable":"no","Default":"—","Classification":"CONFIDENTIAL","Meaning":"Person (identity_persons.id) who made the last change; historical attribution without a foreign key, because the authoritative trail is the identity audit.","Null meaning":"—","Unit":"—"},{"Column":"updated_at","PostgreSQL type":"timestamp(3) with time zone","Nullable":"no","Default":"—","Classification":"INTERNAL","Meaning":"Application-clock instant of the last change; informational, not the concurrency token.","Null meaning":"—","Unit":"—"}],"constraints":[{"Object":"operational_parameters_key_check","Physical definition":"CHECK (((key)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['ai.model'::character varying, 'ai.traceLevel'::character varying, 'access.providerGrants'::character varying, 'channels.whatsapp'::character varying])::text[])))","Purpose":"Only parameters declared by the catalog."},{"Object":"operational_parameters_pkey","Physical definition":"PRIMARY KEY (key)","Purpose":"One saved value per parameter."},{"Object":"operational_parameters_value_check","Physical definition":"CHECK (((value IS NULL) OR (((key)::text = 'ai.model'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'::text) AND ((value #>> '{}'::text[]) ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,99}$'::text)) OR (((key)::text = 'ai.traceLevel'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'::text) AND ((value #>> '{}'::text[]) = ANY (ARRAY['off'::text, 'metadata'::text, 'content'::text]))) OR (((key)::text = 'access.providerGrants'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length(value) <= 32) AND (NOT jsonb_path_exists(value, '$[*]?(@.type() != \"string\")'::jsonpath))) OR (((key)::text = 'channels.whatsapp'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string'::text) AND ((value #>> '{}'::text[]) = ANY (ARRAY['enabled'::text, 'disabled'::text])))))","Purpose":"Each known key holds only its catalog type and domain (model identifier pattern, trace level, list of at most 32 strings, channel switch)."},{"Object":"operational_parameters_version_check","Physical definition":"CHECK ((version >= 1))","Purpose":"Versions start at 1."}]}
